crossRefs.note: You shall put the mercy seat on the ark of the covenant in the most holy place.
He made a mercy seat of pure gold. Its length was two and a half cubits, and a cubit and a half its width.
He took and put the covenant into the ark, and set the poles on the ark, and put the mercy seat above on the ark.
He shall take a censer full of coals of fire from off the altar before Yahweh, and two handfuls of sweet incense beaten…
Then David gave to Solomon his son the plans for the porch of the temple, for its houses, for its treasuries, for its…
whom God sent to be an atoning sacrifice, through faith in his blood, for a demonstration of his righteousness through…
Let’s therefore draw near with boldness to the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy and may find grace for help…
and above it cherubim of glory overshadowing the mercy seat, of which things we can’t speak now in detail.
And he is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not for ours only, but also for the whole world.
